prose: Dr. Barre Lando cohosts the Alfacast with Mike Winner and is the brilliant innovator of longevity teas and other organic supplements at Alfa Vedic. In this episode we get insight into Barre's vast experience in the realm of aetheric physics, advanced dowsing and radiesthesia tools, balancing the subject/object paradox in experimentation, the qualitative dimensions of waveforms, and much more.
ext: Dr Lando shares his thoughts on ascended masters, Steiner's cosmology, the prismatic multiplication of source, holographic blood/body resonance, old school alchemy, and the power of crystals.
